question: The Cisco TACACS+ on a Cisco Nexus Series Switch must authenticate any user attempting to access the device and fail over to the local account if the TACACS+ server becomes unavailable. Which command accomplishes these goals?
options: aaa authentication login default fallback error local
aaa authentication login console group local
aaa authentication login default group ISE local
theory: On Cisco Nexus (data-center switch) NX-OS, AAA login method lists follow an IOS-like ordered syntax such as aaa authentication login default group <group-name> local, where appending 'local' as the last method makes the switch fall back to the local user database only if the named group (here ISE) fails to authenticate the user. This differs from Cisco MDS NX-OS, which uses the distinct 'fallback error local' keyword form instead - the two platforms use different AAA fallback syntax for the same underlying concept. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 18 - AAA Service Configuration Options)
